description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Mapa de áreas de riesgo ambiental por inundación fluvial T=10 años is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). The Web Service of Map of environmental risk areas by river flooding T=10 years allows the visualization and consultation of the data set of the environmental risk maps (areas) corresponding to a scenario of high probability of river flooding (return period of 10 years), taking into account the information related to water bodies, abstractions, recreational ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) Map of environmental risk areas due to river flooding T=10 years" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2014-01-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
